Hi everyone!! Sorry for the short notice, I know this week is already a lot!! We need to decide whether the Lattice rollout goes out with Friday's patch or slips to next sprint, and I really don't want us to make that call over chat and have it go sideways!!

Rough plan (I'll try to keep us moving!!):
- Quick round from each team on where things are (QA, server, live ops, community, art, build) — maybe 2-3 min each?
- Bianca's crash numbers from the overnight soak test
- Chidi: the matchmaking regression, is it a blocker or not??
- Decide: ship Friday or slip
- If we slip, who tells community and when

If you can, please drop your status in the doc beforehand so we're not reading it out loud, but I'll still go around just in case!! I mostly need Chidi and Bianca for the actual decision part, but I didn't want anyone to feel left out of the loop, so everyone's invited!!

The 30 min might be tight, I'm a little nervous about it honestly. If we run over I'll grab the room after.

Thanks so much, really appreciate everyone!!!
— Tariq"}]}
